commands.command:
set -eu
id
if [ -e /swapfile ]; then ls -l /swapfile; else echo '/swapfile absent'; fi
awk '$1=="/swapfile" {print}' /etc/fstab || true

set -eu
umask 077
dd if=/dev/zero of=/swapfile bs=1M count=512 conv=fsync
chmod 600 /swapfile
ls -l /swapfile
stat -c 'bytes=%s mode=%a owner=%U:%G' /swapfile

commands.command:
set -eu
if awk '$1=="/swapfile" && $3=="swap" {found=1} END {exit(found ? 0 : 1)}' /etc/fstab; then
  echo 'swapfile fstab entry already present'
else
  printf '%s\n' '/swapfile none swap sw 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
printf '%s\n' '--- swap fstab entry ---'
awk '$1=="/swapfile" {print NR ":" $0}' /etc/fstab
commands.stdout:
